From the greenhouse

Plant-care tips

💧

Water less than you think

Most houseplants die from overwatering. Let the top inch of soil dry out before reaching for the can.

☀️

Read the light

Match each plant to its spot. Bright indirect means near a window but out of harsh direct rays.

🪴

Repot in spring

Roots circling the pot? Size up by one pot and refresh with peat-free soil as growth wakes up.

🍃

Dust the leaves

Clean leaves photosynthesize better. Wipe broad foliage monthly with a damp cloth.
